# Goldspade — Forged for Founders

> Goldspade is an engineering-led digital studio headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India. We design and build bespoke business websites, high-performance web applications, custom business software, and pragmatic AI integrations for ambitious founders and enterprises across Maharashtra, Karnataka, and India.

## Studio Profile & Facts
- **Official Website**: https://goldspade.in
- **Headquarters**: Pune, Maharashtra, India (Postal Code: 411001)
- **Founder & Principal Architect**: Rohit Pote
- **Direct Contact**: hello@goldspade.in | +91 8390612060
- **Primary Practices**: Website Design & Development, Custom Software Engineering, Web Application Development, Progressive Web Apps (PWAs), AI Integration & Process Automation, Technical SEO Architecture.
- **Operating Model**: Direct collaboration with founding principal engineers, 2-week agile sprints, 100% intellectual property and source code ownership transferred to clients.
- **Commercial Investment Ranges**: Business websites typically ₹25,000 to ₹1,50,000; custom software and web applications ₹1,00,000 to ₹5,00,000+.

## Core Services & Dedicated Capabilities
- [Website Design & Development](https://goldspade.in/services/website-design-development): High-speed bespoke marketing flagships, corporate websites, and editorial experiences engineered in Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with sub-second Core Web Vitals.
- [Web Application Development & SaaS Engineering](https://goldspade.in/services/custom-software-web-applications): Scalable web applications, authenticated client portals, multi-tenant SaaS dashboards, and high-concurrency systems.
- [Custom Software Development](https://goldspade.in/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke business software, internal operations tools, and database systems that eliminate spreadsheet chaos.
- [Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) & Mobile](https://goldspade.in/services/mobile-app-development): Installable, offline-first Progressive Web Apps operating with zero App Store friction or platform commission fees.
- [Custom E-Commerce Development](https://goldspade.in/services/ecommerce-development): High-converting digital storefronts with instant catalog filtering and certified Indian payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, UPI).
- [Product Engineering & MVP Architecture](https://goldspade.in/services/product-engineering): End-to-end technical co-building for technology startups, from architectural roadmap to production launch.
- [AI Integration & Business Automation](https://goldspade.in/services/ai-integration-automation): Practical AI integrations using foundation APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic), semantic search, and document extraction.
- [Operations, Inventory & Billing Software](https://goldspade.in/services/erp-inventory-operations-software): Specialized operational software, bilingual inventory management, and billing consoles for retailers and distributors.
- [Technical SEO & Performance Architecture](https://goldspade.in/services/technical-seo-performance): Comprehensive Schema.org graphs, sub-second Core Web Vitals, semantic HTML5, and search engine crawlability engineering.

## Verified Portfolio & Case Studies
- [BrandBattle](https://goldspade.in/work/brandbattle): AI-powered product comparison and price-intelligence platform evaluating hardware across 50+ vectors with sub-second filtering.
- [Nityasādhanā](https://goldspade.in/work/nityasadhana): Calm devotional habit and reporting Progressive Web App for devotees and counselors at ISKCON Pune, eliminating spreadsheet tracking.
- [Saanjgarva](https://goldspade.in/work/saanjgarva): Specialized operational PWA for Saanj Garva managing bar stock inventory, daily sales, and customer credit (udhari) with bilingual Marathi and English support.
- [Jar](https://goldspade.in/work/jar): Practical offline-first delivery and bottle inventory PWA for Sai Water Suppliers in Kolewadi, tracking 20L water-jar logistics and customer ledgers.
- [Mamacha Mala](https://goldspade.in/work/mamacha-mala): Immersive culinary showcase and digital flagship for Hotel Mamacha Mala in Khodshi, Karad, presenting wood-fire (chulivarel) dining and direct inquiry routing.
- [Hotel Atithi Karad](https://goldspade.in/work/hotel-atithi-karad): Regional hospitality digital showcase for Hotel Atithi Karad presenting family garden dining, regional menus, and highway traveler discovery.
- [EZdukkan](https://goldspade.in/work/ezdukkan): Streamlined operational management and fast invoicing tool designed for modern retail merchants.
- [Mayuri Developer](https://goldspade.in/work/mayuri-developer): Premium real estate and architectural web platform engineered for a property developer in Pune.

## Published Engineering Research & Guides
- [How Much Does a Custom Business Website Cost in India?](https://goldspade.in/journal/business-website-cost-india-founders-guide): A candid founder's guide to scope, technical architecture, hidden agency costs, and measuring ROI.
- [Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) vs Native Mobile Apps](https://goldspade.in/journal/progressive-web-apps-vs-native-apps-guide): Comparing App Store download drop-off against instant PWA installs and offline caching for growing businesses.
- [When Does a Business Need Custom Software? Replacing Spreadsheets](https://goldspade.in/journal/replace-spreadsheets-custom-business-software-guide): How Indian enterprises identify spreadsheet failure and transition to scalable, custom-built applications.
- [How to Choose a Web Development Partner in India](https://goldspade.in/journal/how-to-choose-web-development-partner-india-guide): Practical criteria for evaluating freelancers, traditional agencies, and engineering studios.
